product_metadata.title: Black+Decker CM1160B 12-Cup Programmable Coffee Maker, Black/Stainless Steel
features: Please refer to user guide or user manual or user guide (provided below in PDF) before first use
description: Brew your daily coffee fast with the BLACK+DECKER 12-Cup* Programmable Coffeemaker. QuickTouch Programming buttons make it easy to set the 24-hour auto brew feature and shave some time off of your morning routine. Other useful features include Sneak-A-Cup Technology, the 12-Cup* Duralife glass carafe, and a washable brew basket. Black+Decker and the Black+Decker logo are trademarks of The Black & Decker Corporation and are used under license. *Cup equals approximately 5 oz. (varies by brewing technique)
